not_verified: Large model weights were not rehashed in this audit; stored weight manifests and paths/sizes were inspected. Prior download/hash verification is not repeated here.
No inference was rerun. Runtime CUDA/RNG execution cannot be reconstructed solely from saved images; frozen execution source, requests and recorded inference fields were checked.
No geometric correctness, hole/topology preservation, photorealism, iPhone ISP correspondence, or downstream training utility is certified.
Visual interpretation remains separate from this technical audit; all candidates remain unaccepted development outputs.

All six source binary object masks have zero enclosed 2D background holes, so the enclosed-hole coverage predicate is vacuous on this panel. Convex-hull background coverage is nonvacuous, including 1,914 pixels inside the arch region of 00269315; this does not constitute a separate drilled-hole geometry test.
evidence_interpretation: Guard saved masks cover original CAD, enclosed holes and the convex-hull interior. This is a compositing guarantee for those pixels, not a guarantee of unchanged geometry outside the protection region.
No-record or absent summary would be reported as incomplete rather than inferred complete from elapsed time. All eight run summaries were present at audit time.
RGB difference, clipping, successful generation and exact pasted pixels do not measure realism.
Kontext and Krea comparisons differ in generation mechanism and prompts; they are candidate comparisons rather than a single-factor model ablation.

depth_off and depth_on use the same pipeline/full-frame sampling, fixed source/seed/prompt and differ only in conditioning scale. Later guard and matte runs are sequential development, not frozen independent evaluation.
